title: sdr-daily-scratchpad-emma-garcia-2026-03-09
content:
Daily scratchpad - quick wins, call list, follow-ups, pipeline notes.

Morning priorities:
- hit daily dials goal: 60 calls (need 35 more)
- follow-ups for MQLs from last week (priority: High)
- reply to inbox: 10 quick replies before noon
- update Outreach sequences for Mid-Market playbook (see Confluence-1234)

Call list (9am-11:30am block):
1) 09:05 AM - Brightleaf Health (Account: Brightleaf) - spoke to Sarah (ops). Note: interested in latency/cost comparison to our hosted API. Action: send tailored one-pager + benchmark snippet. 
   - Email template: "Hi Sarah - quick follow-up with latency/cost snapshot vs current provider. Attached one-pager and demo invite?"
   - Next step: send by 10:00, add to sequence 3 if no response in 3 days.
2) 09:30 AM - Orion Retail (Account: Orion) - left voicemail (no answer). VM script: "Emma from Redwood Inference, quick note on dedicated capacity savings + can share a customer case study. Call me back x"
   - Action: follow up with email + case study link.
3) 10:00 AM - Cobalt Finance (Account: Cobalt) - Warm intro from partner. Decision maker: Priya (platform). Note: compliance questions (VPC, KMS).
   - Prep: pull Private deployment doc + compliance checklist (link to Confluence-1234). Schedule 30m demo.
4) 10:45 AM - Nova Ads (Account: Nova) - interested in embeddings for semantic search. Wants pricing ballpark for 50k queries/day.
   - Action: calculate estimate using Optimize recommendations, attach calc sheet.

Afternoon follow-ups (1:30pm-4:30pm):
- Follow up: Brightleaf (email sent?) - track in Outreach sequence.
- Send VM-to-email to Orion with case study.
- Sync w/SE (Maya) at 2:15pm to prep demo deck for Cobalt; bring compliance appendix.
- Quick sync w/Noah at 3:00pm to review quota pacing and top accounts to push this week.

Pipeline notes / context snippets:
- Brightleaf Health - POC interest, trial requests, latency is primary blocker. Potential ARR: $120k ARR if POC successful. Champion: Sarah (ops). Risk: procurement cycle long.
- Orion Retail - Ads recommendation engine; high token volumes. Could be a Dedicated deal, talk to AE/SE about capacity pricing.
- Cobalt Finance - Regulated industry, leaning Private. Need security packaging + SOC2/PCI artifacts.
- Nova Ads - small-medium ARR, good quick-win for Optimize upsell (batching + quantization).

Quick templates / snippets to reuse:
- VM script: "Hey this is Emma Garcia at Redwood Inference. We help teams reduce token cost and latency for LLM features while keeping data private. Would love to share a quick benchmark and customer case study. Give me a call back at (555) 555-1212 or shoot a time. Thanks!"
- Email follow-up short: "Hi {{first_name}}, quick follow-up on my voicemail - attaching a short case study that shows ~30% cost reductions for streaming LLM use-cases. Want to hop on a 20-min call this week?"
- Pricing ask reply: "For 50k queries/day with avg 200 tokens/query, rough monthly estimate: $Xk-$Yk on Hosted API; Dedicated reserved capacity options often reduce unit cost by ~30-45% depending on commit. Happy to run exact calc - want me to prepare one?"

To-dos (tick when done):
- [ ] Send Brightleaf one-pager + latency benchmark (due 10:00)
- [ ] Email Orion case study + demo invite (due 11:30)
- [ ] Prep compliance docs for Cobalt demo (Maya + SE) (due 2:00)
- [ ] Run cost calc for Nova (attach sheet) (due EOD)
- [ ] Update Outreach sequences: add new step for VM-to-email (template saved)

Notes to self / ideas:
- Ask Product to add a short FAQ for "Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private" for quick objections. Link request in Confluence.
- Capture a one-pager showing "latency vs cost tradeoffs" for common architectures (streaming chat, embeddings, rerank). Could be good for Brightleaf pitch.
- Experiment: shorter VM (15s) + SMS follow-up for mobile-first roles. Track response rate for 1 week.
